technical.summary: Mixed technicals with short-term oversold bounce signals conflicting with bearish intermediate trend structure and price below all key moving averages; insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: ROK shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 42 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent score 11) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 sale, 1 purchase, small amounts) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (383.5) with flat yield curve, FOMC event today, and macro_score of -5 create severely adverse conditions; earnings in 42 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI 9 oversold (rsi_9_oversold) + supertrend bullish + 15x volume spike + extreme fear sentiment (VIX crisis) create textbook contrarian bounce setup near support at 185.71.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages (20/50/200 EMA/SMA), Ichimoku below cloud, VWAP rejection, bearish momentum (AO negative, PSAR bearish), zero fundamental support, FOMC event today, and macro_score -5 with unfavourable environment eliminate confluence and create unacceptable event risk.

decision.entry_rationale: RSI 9 oversold and 15x volume spike present tactical bounce setup, but price rejection below all major moving averages and bearish momentum structure eliminate confluence required for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC event today combined with macro_score -5 and VIX crisis (383.5) create unacceptable event risk; earnings in 42 days add secondary event risk that conflicts with swing timeframe.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical bounce signals insufficient to overcome fundamental void, sentiment confirmation absence, and macro crisis conditions
decision.portfolio_note: Existing ROK position + 12 open Industrials positions (16% sector concentration) further reduce conviction; skip preserves capital for higher-conviction setups.
